description: List the Specification Sets in a Project

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The ID of the project for the new set

id.description: Unique identifier for the specification set.

project_id.description: ID of the project the specification set belongs to.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns the specification set.

created_at.description: Date the specification set was created.

deleted_at.description: Date the specification set was deleted. Null if not deleted.

updated_at.description: Date the specification set was last updated.

date.description: Date associated with the specification set. Null if not set.

position.description: Sort position of the specification set. Null if not set.

401.description: Company or project is not valid, user is not an active contact, company does not have an ERP connection
